disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: Read through the repository README, development guide (AGENTS.md), design documents, and research notes; checked for injection patterns such as "ignore instructions", disguised system messages, remote-fetched instructions, hidden text, etc. Zero hits. AGENTS.md content is normal development guidance (coding conventions, build, test, release), with no injection wording. Also confirmed that the plugin provides no compression engine or attachment storage implementation, so no related context-tampering surface exists.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何模型可见工具，也没有向系统提示注入片段；/context 命令的候选文案为普通功能说明（src/client/i18n.ts:104），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-visible tools and injects no snippets into the system prompt; the /context command's candidate copy is ordinary functional description (src/client/i18n.ts:104), containing no system directives or wording that induces credential reading.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明自身条目，不含可执行 JS 表达式（!!js）；未发现混淆代码或动态解码执行模式。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); the patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single-line insert declaring its own entry, with no executable JS expressions (!!js); no obfuscated code or dynamic decode-and-execute patterns found.

checked_items.zh: 客户端包声明了浏览器端加载（dsh.client），专项检查了全部键盘监听：contextModal.tsx 中监听 Escape 键关闭弹窗，images.tsx 中监听 Escape 键关闭图片灯箱，均不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板、凭据 RPC 调用或异常外联。
checked_items.en: The client package declares a browser-side load (dsh.client). A dedicated check of all keyboard listeners: contextModal.tsx listens for Escape to close the modal, images.tsx listens for Escape to close the image lightbox; neither records keystroke content. No clipboard access, credential RPC calls, or abnormal outbound connections found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明，不含可执行 JS 表达式；仓库内其他 YAML 中出现的 !!js 字样均位于研究笔记文档（docs/research/），是介绍 dsh 宿主机制的说明文字，不是插件补丁内容。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single-line insert declaration with no executable JS expressions; occurrences of !!js elsewhere in the repository YAML files are all in research notes (docs/research/), which are explanatory text about the dsh host mechanism, not plugin patch content.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态执行工具（如 cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），已对其专项检查：唯一的键盘监听用于弹窗 Escape 关闭（contextModal.tsx:77）和图片灯箱 Escape 关闭（images.tsx:72），不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或键盘记录行为。

No clipboard reads, credential RPC calls, or keylogging behavior found.

evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, does not call registerAdapter to register a custom LLM adapter, and has no runtime LLM routing hijacking surface.

limits.en:
The plugin manifest (dsh field in package.json) does not explicitly declare capability fields; the capability statements in this report are filled based on code observation: network capability is true (an outbound version check request to the official npm registry exists), and all other capabilities are false.

Dynamic sandbox was not enabled (L4 = na), and no runtime verification was performed.

All 11 static pre-scan hits were adjudicated individually (rule IDs per item):
(1) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml is a PR-check CI that runs on GitHub infrastructure and is not executed during plugin installation; it is routine engineering practice and is excluded.
(2) DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: .github/workflows/release.yml is a CI workflow for the author's npm publishing (OIDC trusted publishing), runs on GitHub infrastructure and is not executed during plugin installation; excluded.
(3) DSH-C05/DG-R4-53: In .oxlintrc.json:193, the code style rule name object-curly-spacing contains the substring curl, which was falsely matched by the curl pattern; it is not an outbound behavior and is excluded.
(4) DSH-X10/DG-R2-57: AGENTS.md is a development guide containing normal coding conventions, build/test, and release instructions, with no injection wording; excluded.
(5-7) DSH-P01/DG-R3-51: In docs/research/dsh-monorepo-and-plugin-practices.md:31,34,35, three occurrences of !!js are all research notes describing the dsh host mechanism, not plugin patch content (the plugin's own cordis.patch.yml has no !!js); excluded.
(8) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55: Same research note at :35 describes the host loader's new Function mechanism, not plugin code; excluded.
(9) DSH-X03/DG-R3-55: scripts/bundle-smoke.mjs:58 uses new Function(bundle)() to run the bundled artifact in a test environment; it is a development helper script and is not in the released file list (release contains only lib/client.js, lib/index.js, lib/index.d.ts, cordis.patch.yml, README.md, LICENSE); excluded.
(10) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: The keyboard listener in src/client/components/contextModal.tsx:77 only closes the modal on Escape and does not record keystrokes; excluded.
(11) DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: The keyboard listener in src/client/components/images.tsx:72 only closes the image lightbox on Escape and does not record keystrokes; excluded.

Plugin compatibility is based on static compatibility-layer code (compat.ts) and development documentation declarations, with no runtime verification performed.
